artworks.title: Old Man with a Beard
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.1 x 10.9 cm (5 9/16 x 4 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a black and white sketch of an older man, depicting his head and shoulders. He faces slightly to the right with a thoughtful expression. The man has deep-set eyes, prominent cheekbones, and a bald head with sparse hair. He has a long, thick beard blending with the fur-like texture of his cloak, which is fastened with a circular clasp. The background is dark and textured, highlighting the man's facial features and clothing.

artworks.title: Cottages by a River
artworks.medium: black chalk with touches of graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with thatched-roof houses next to a canal. The horizon is low with houses and trees lining the water. The drawing is sketchy with loose pencil strokes. Details are more pronounced in the foreground and fade as we look towards the canal and distant boats. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of grey and black, emphasizing the tranquil and rustic nature of the scene.

artworks.title: A Young Man Playing a Psalterium
artworks.artist: Christoffel van Sichem I after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to borderline): 30.8 x 21.6 cm (12 1/8 x 8 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person's body, including the head and upper torso. The person is seated and turned slightly to the side, looking over their shoulder directly at the viewer with a neutral expression. They have distinct facial features with a broad nose and are depicted with shoulder-length, wavy hair that peeks out from under a large, elaborate hat. The hat appears to be adorned with feathers and a decorative band. The individual is dressed in a finely detailed garment featuring puffed sleeves and intricate embroidery or trimming along the neckline. Surrounding them is another person, positioned slightly behind and to the side, wearing a draped hood that frames their face. There are also several other figures in the background, some wearing similar attire with headdresses. The setting appears to be an interior or a balcony-like space with architectural elements, such as columns and a railing, visible in the background. The entire composition is rendered in a detailed, line-based style typical of woodcuts or engravings of the period.

artworks.title: The Monkeys' Barber Shop
artworks.artist: Coryn Boel after David Teniers the Younger
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 24.7 x 32 cm (9 3/4 x 12 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of monkeys engaging in human-like activities in a barbershop. The scene shows monkeys dressed in human clothing, performing tasks typically associated with a barbershop. In the foreground, two monkeys are grooming another monkey's foot at a low table. To the right, one monkey is sitting on a chair wrapped in a cloth, while another monkey attends to its face with a basin of water nearby. In the background, a shelf holds various bottles and containers. The walls feature a mirror and a bird perched on a shelf.

artworks.title: Metamorphoses of the Day: A Conventional Marriage
Metamorphoses of the Day: Regrets, or Never till the Next Time
The Ailing Cricket
artworks.description: This is a print of anthropomorphic bugs in a colorful scene. The scene features three standing creatures with gray, wrinkly heads similar to those of worms, who appear to be attending to another creature who sits in a blue chair on the right. This creature has a green-and-yellow face similar to that of a cricket with two tall antennae. All four creatures are dressed extravagantly, with long jackets in shades of pale blue, green, orange, and brown over shirts, vests, and trousers. Two of the worm-like creatures have tall top hats, and one has a walking stick and yellow gloves on its human-like hands. They all face the seated cricket, and one stands beside the cricket, holding one of its wrists. To the right of the cricket is a table that holds glass bottles and a folded paper or pamphlet. The print is centered on off-white paper, and there are some lines of text above and below it.

artworks.title: Vauxhall Gardens
artworks.artist: Robert Pollard and Francis Jukes after Thomas Rowlandson, published by John Raphael Smith
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of an outdoor social gathering in a garden with a grand architectural structure. The scene features numerous figures in period clothing, gathered around a central pavilion adorned with intricate patterns and surrounded by tall trees. The architecture includes a dual-level balcony where some figures are observing the gathering below. The overall atmosphere is festive, suggesting a place of leisure and social interaction. This artwork is done in the style of Thomas Rowlandson.

artworks.title: An Old Man Reading
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The artwork depicts a man seated at a desk, engrossed in reading a large open book in front of him. He has a prominent nose, full beard, curly unkempt hair, and wears a textured robe. To his right, there is a large globe on a stand. The background shows detailed etching with light and shadow.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Young Man in Uniform
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a young person in a slightly tilted position, looking towards the viewer. They have fair skin, delicate facial features, eyes slightly widened, and softly closed lips. The person's hair is styled in a powdered 18th-century fashion with curls and tied with a ribbon. They wear a blue coat with red and gray trim, adorned with buttons. The background is a simple, muted grayish-brown tone.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Young Man in Uniform
artworks.description: The person in the image is shown from the chest up. They are facing slightly to their right, looking directly at the viewer. The individual has pale skin, prominent eyes, and a slight smile. Their hair is powdered white, styled back and tied with a black ribbon. They are wearing an ornate blue coat with red and silver trim, intricate silver embellishments, and epaulettes on the shoulders. Their attire includes a high black collar and a cravat. The background is plain and neutral. There are no visible jewelry or accessories.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Young Man in Profile
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the chest up, in a profile position facing left. The individual has short, dark hair and a smooth complexion. They are wearing a blue garment with gold buttons and a high white collar, underneath a darker layer. There are no visible jewelry or objects held by the person. The background is a neutral grayish-brown color, with a subtle oval frame around the figure.

artworks.title: Hellene von Sleben
artworks.description: The image features a profile portrait of a woman from the waist up, facing right. She has fair skin, a prominent nose, an updo hairstyle with curls by the ear, and a floral headpiece with blue leaves and a white flower. She wears a blue dress with a low neckline, short white sleeves, and two pearl necklaces around her neck. The background is a soft, muted brown oval.

artworks.title: Madame La Duchesse de Mortemart
artworks.medium: watercolor with gray wash and touches of gouache over red and black chalks on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated in profile, with her full body visible and slightly reclined in an ornate chair. She wears a voluminous blue gown adorned with white lace trim, and her hands are delicately clasped together in her lap. Her facial features are finely detailed with a light complexion, rosy cheeks, and an expression of calm contemplation. Her hair is styled in a traditional manner, partially covered by a matching blue bonnet. The chair she sits in is upholstered in green fabric with a floral pattern and has a wooden frame. In the background, there are lush trees and a distant landscape, alongside a large architectural stone element to the left.

artworks.title: Seated Guitarist [recto]
artworks.description: The image depicts a person seated with their legs extended, turned to the left. They are holding a musical instrument, wearing a wide-brimmed hat, a coat, pants, and shoes. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Treetops [verso]
artworks.medium: black and red chalks with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a lightly sketched forested landscape from a straightforward, eye-level perspective. Tall, slender trees obscure the horizon. The soft brushstrokes create a subtle depiction of the trees in muted gray and earthy brown tones. Tree silhouettes in the distance add depth and texture to the scene.

artworks.title: Design for a Border with a Portrait of Baron Cuvier
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate decorative border featuring a variety of natural elements. The rectangular blank space is framed with intricate pencil drawings depicting flora and fauna. The border includes tropical plants, a leopard, a fox, a snake, various birds, a person, an animal, plants, flowers, animals such as frogs, fish, and reptiles, insects like butterflies and dragonflies, fruits, foliage, and additional natural elements. Two small drawings are included within the vertical borders, and the bottom center features a prominent butterfly image.

artworks.title: Two Russians Seated in Landscape
artworks.medium: brown chalk on beige laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals seated on the ground. The person on the left has their arm around the shoulders of the person on the right. Both individuals have facial features, hair styled neatly, and wear long garments. The person on the left wears a headdress. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background includes a wooden fence and foliage.

artworks.title: Sancho Fleeing from the Servants of the Duke
artworks.medium: black chalk and gray wash heightened with white gouache on light brown laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows figures in dynamic poses in a classical architectural setting. Individuals are interacting with each other in a grand environment with columns and draped fabrics. In the foreground, dishes and objects are scattered. Tall columns and elaborate detailing add to the grandiosity of the scene, while shading and line work provide depth and texture, capturing the expressions and movement of the figures.

artworks.title: Landscape View
artworks.medium: gray wash with graphite on laid paper; black chalk study of male nude on verso
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rustic buildings surrounded by rolling hills and a serene countryside. The brushstrokes are delicate and subtle, focusing on fine details. The color palette is mainly greys and soft tones. Near the foreground, two figures are reclining on the grass, with more figures near a well further away. Fields, walls, and trees lead towards the structures and vegetation in the distance, creating depth in the scene.

artworks.title: View of a Port
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing a serene scene. A group of trees is drawn on the left, while a weathered building with maritime equipment is on the right. In the background, there are faint sketches of ships and a lighthouse against a pale sky. The color palette is dominated by shades of brown and sepia, creating an antiquated atmosphere.

artworks.title: Young French Marquise in Exile in Lausanne
artworks.description: The image shows three people and a dog within a domestic scene. The first person is a woman holding a child, who is playing with a dog. To the right, another woman is standing. A young boy is kneeling in the foreground, looking into a vessel emitting smoke. The background shows a rustic attic setting with wooden beams, curtains, a messy table, a hat on the floor, and a quilt-covered bed in the corner. Light from a window on the left casts a soft glow over the scene.

artworks.title: Allegory of Fame
artworks.medium: red chalk with traces of graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is an image of allegorical figures surrounded by clouds. Several classical figures draped in robes and adorned with laurels or other decorative headpieces are engaging in a ceremonious scene. A central figure, who appears to be youthful and partially clothed, is holding laurel wreaths, while other figures are interacting with or presenting items to them. They stand surrounded by swirling clouds or ethereal forms, contributing to a celestial or mythological atmosphere. The artwork features intricate line work and detailed expressions characteristic of neoclassical or mythological art styles.

artworks.title: Man Falling from the Sky
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with blue wash and touches of black ink, incised for transfer, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a nude figure suspended above a landscape with symbols of power below. The composition includes a central, nude figure in the air, surrounded by objects like crowns, a scepter, and a sword. The background features a faint landscape sketch with hills or mountains. The artwork uses muted colors and intricate detailing, suggesting a historical or allegorical theme related to power and possessions.
